e.title: ExamPrep AI
e.summary: syllabus/真题/笔记 → 排好序的备考路线图 + 考题预测 + flashcards
e.body: examprep-ai 把 syllabus、past papers、笔记转成按 Easy→Medium→Hard 排序的 High Score Roadmap，支持理论/数值/MCQ/编码分类、考题预测与备考就绪度检查。对本站：可把「MT Sample Exam」「FN 复习范围 Ch6/7/8/24」这类材料生成复习词条，服务 [[mpfe]]、[[iiqe-1]] 等考牌路线。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：SKILL.md 能力已读，未实测
e.summary_en: Syllabus/past papers/notes → ranked High Score Roadmap, question prediction, flashcards
e.summary_hk: syllabus/真題/筆記 → 排好序的備考路線圖 + 考題預測 + flashcards
e.body_en: examprep-ai converts syllabi, past papers and notes into a High Score Roadmap ordered Easy→Medium→Hard, covering theory/numerical/MCQ/coding prep, question prediction and readiness checks. For this site: materials such as "MT Sample Exam" and "FN review scope Ch6/7/8/24" can generate review entries serving the [[mpfe]] and [[iiqe-1]] credential tracks.
e.body_hk: examprep-ai 把 syllabus、past papers、筆記轉成按 Easy→Medium→Hard 排序的 High Score Roadmap，支持理論/數值/MCQ/編碼分類、考題預測與備考就緒度檢查。對本站：可把「MT Sample Exam」「FN 複習範圍 Ch6/7/8/24」這類材料生成複習詞條，服務 [[mpfe]]、[[iiqe-1]] 等考牌路線。
